title: Travel Expense Approval Policy
text: All travel expenses must be approved in advance by the employee's direct manager. Expenses over 500 dollars also require approval from the Finance department. Employees must submit the request in the expense system at least five days before the trip. After the trip, receipts must be attached within ten business days. Expenses without receipts will not be reimbursed.

title: Purchasing and Supplier Request Process
text: To make a purchase, the requester fills out a purchase requisition form and sends it to Purchasing. Purchasing requests at least three quotes from approved suppliers. The requisition must be approved by the budget owner. Once approved, Purchasing issues the purchase order and follows up on delivery. Any purchase outside this process must be justified in writing.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with approval from their direct manager. Employees must be available during business hours and reachable through official channels. Remote work does not apply to operational roles that require physical presence. This policy is reviewed every year and any exception must be approved by senior management.

title: Monthly Accounting Close Procedure
text: The accounting close takes place during the first five business days of each month. Each department must submit accruals and pending invoices before the third day. Accounting reconciles bank accounts, records accruals and prepares the financial statements. The Finance director reviews and approves the close. Later adjustments require written approval.

title: New Supplier Onboarding Process
text: To register a new supplier, the following documents are required: tax registration, bank account statement and a signed contract. Purchasing validates the documents and sends them to Finance for registration in the system. The process takes about five business days. Purchase orders cannot be issued to suppliers that are not registered.

title: Meeting Minutes: Approval Process Review
text: Attendees: Finance, Purchasing and Operations. The team reviewed the current approval workflow for expenses and purchases. Requests currently take an average of eight days to be approved. Agreements: reduce approval levels for small amounts, document the new process and communicate it to all departments before the end of the month. Owner: Purchasing.

title: Document Retention Policy
text: Accounting and tax documents must be kept for at least five years. Contracts are kept for the duration of the contract plus five years. Each department is responsible for filing its documents in the official repository. Document destruction must be approved by Legal and recorded in the retention log.

title: Notice: Approval Workflow Change
text: Starting Monday, small purchase approvals will be done directly in the system.

title: Ticket: VPN Will Not Connect
text: Ticket #1024. User reports that the VPN will not connect from home and shows a timeout error. Support verified that the user's access is enabled. Resolution: the VPN client was reinstalled and the certificate was updated. The user confirms the connection now works. Status: closed. Priority: medium.

title: Ticket: Third Floor Printer Not Printing
text: Ticket #1031. Several users report that the third floor printer is not printing and jobs are stuck in the queue. Support checked the print server and the print service was stopped. Resolution: the print service was restarted and the queue was cleared. Status: closed. Priority: low.

title: Incident: ERP System Outage
text: Critical incident. The ERP system stopped responding at 9:15 and affected Sales, Purchasing and Finance. The support team escalated the incident to the vendor. The root cause was a full disk on the database server. Disk space was freed and the service was restored at 11:40. Pending action: configure disk space alerts.

title: Ticket: Email Password Reset
text: Ticket #1045. User cannot log in to email because they forgot their password and the account was locked. Support verified the user's identity by phone. Resolution: the account was unlocked and a temporary password was sent. Status: closed. Priority: high.

title: Postmortem: Office Network Slowness
text: Incident summary: for two days users reported slow network performance and slow access to applications. Root cause: a switch with outdated firmware was causing packet loss. Resolution: the firmware was updated and a damaged cable was replaced. Lessons learned: monitor network traffic and schedule preventive maintenance.

title: Ticket: Laptop Will Not Turn On
text: Ticket #1052. User reports that their laptop will not turn on after an update. Support tried a forced restart without success. Resolution: a loaner laptop was provided and the device was sent to the vendor under warranty. Status: waiting on vendor. Priority: high.

title: Ticket: Shared Folder Access Error
text: Ticket #1060. User reports an access denied error when opening a shared folder for the Sales team. Support reviewed the permissions and the user was not in the correct group. Resolution: the user was added to the group with approval from the team manager. Status: closed. Priority: medium.

title: Ticket: Not Working
text: It is not working, this is urgent, please check.

title: Vacation Policy
text: Employees are entitled to vacation days based on their years of service, according to labor law. Vacation must be requested at least fifteen days in advance and approved by the direct manager. Human Resources keeps track of available days. Unused days cannot be carried over for more than one year.

title: New Employee Onboarding Process
text: On the first day, Human Resources welcomes the new employee, signs the employment contract and hands over the employee handbook. During the first week the employee attends orientation training on company culture, policies and benefits. The direct manager assigns a mentor and sets goals for the first ninety days.

title: Annual Performance Review
text: The performance review takes place every December. The employee completes a self-assessment and the direct manager evaluates goals and competencies. Results are discussed in a feedback meeting. Human Resources uses the review to decide salary increases, promotions and development plans.

title: Employee Benefits and Health Insurance
text: All employees receive major medical insurance, meal vouchers and a savings fund. Health insurance covers the employee, their partner and their children. To add a dependent, the employee must send the required documents to Human Resources. Benefits start on the first day of employment.

title: Meeting Minutes: Workplace Climate Committee
text: Attendees: Human Resources and representatives from each department. The results of the employee engagement survey were presented. Employees asked for more training and better communication with their managers. Agreements: launch a quarterly training program and hold monthly meetings between managers and teams. Owner: Human Resources.

title: Employee Offboarding Process
text: When an employee leaves the company, the direct manager notifies Human Resources. Human Resources calculates the final payment and schedules an exit interview. The employee must return their equipment, badge and access cards. Human Resources asks IT to disable the employee's accounts on their last day.

title: Employee Training Program
text: Human Resources offers training courses on technical skills, leadership and communication. Employees can enroll with approval from their direct manager. Each employee must complete at least twenty hours of training per year. Certificates are recorded in the employee's file.

title: Post: Celebrating the Company Anniversary
text: This Friday we celebrate the company anniversary with a lunch for all employees. Thank you all for your hard work.

title: Password Policy
text: Passwords must be at least twelve characters long and include uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers and symbols. Passwords must be changed every ninety days and the last five passwords cannot be reused. Sharing passwords or writing them in visible places is prohibited. After five failed login attempts the account is locked for security.

title: Alert: Phishing Emails
text: The information security team detected phishing emails pretending to come from Finance and asking employees to update their bank details. Do not open links or download attachments from unknown senders. Always check the sender's address. If you received one of these emails, report it immediately to the security team and delete it.

title: Acceptable Use Policy for Company Devices
text: Company computers are for work use only. Installing unauthorized software, disabling the antivirus or connecting unknown USB devices is prohibited. Devices must be locked when leaving the workstation. The information security team may audit devices at any time to verify compliance.

title: Information Classification
text: Company information is classified as public, internal, confidential or restricted. Confidential information can only be shared with authorized staff and must be encrypted when sent by email. Restricted information requires approval from the information owner before access is granted. Every employee is responsible for protecting the information they handle.

title: Security Incident Response Procedure
text: In case of a security incident, such as a virus, unauthorized access or data leak, the employee must report it immediately to support and the security team. The team isolates the affected device, analyzes the cause and contains the incident. The incident is then documented and actions are defined to prevent it from happening again.

title: Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication
text: Starting next month, multi-factor authentication will be mandatory for email, VPN and internal systems. Each employee must install the authenticator app on their phone and register their account. Multi-factor authentication reduces the risk of unauthorized access even if a password is stolen.

title: Data Backup Policy
text: Servers are backed up daily and backups are stored encrypted in an offsite location. Employees must save their work files in the corporate cloud folder, which is backed up automatically. The information security team tests backup restoration every quarter.

title: News: Rise in Ransomware Attacks
text: Recent security reports show an increase in ransomware attacks against mid-sized companies. Attackers encrypt company data and demand a ransom. The main recommendations are to keep backups up to date, apply security patches and train employees to recognize phishing.

title: FAQ: How Do I Request Vacation?
text: Question: How do I request vacation? Answer: Log in to the Human Resources portal, select the vacation option, choose your dates and send the request to your direct manager. You will receive an email when the request is approved. You can check your available days in the same portal.

title: FAQ: How Do I Get an Expense Reimbursed?
text: Question: How do I get an expense reimbursed? Answer: Enter the expense in the expense system, attach the receipt and submit it for approval. Once your manager approves it, Finance pays the reimbursement on the next payment date. Expenses without receipts are not reimbursed.

title: FAQ: How Do I Connect to the VPN?
text: Question: How do I connect to the VPN from home? Answer: Open the VPN client installed on your laptop, enter your username and password and confirm with the authenticator app. If you cannot connect, open a ticket with support and include the error message.

title: FAQ: How Do I Book a Meeting Room?
text: Question: How do I book a meeting room? Answer: In your email calendar, create a meeting and add the room as a guest. If the room is available, the booking is confirmed automatically. Rooms can be booked for a maximum of two hours.

title: FAQ: Where Can I Find the Official Templates?
text: Question: Where can I find the official presentation and document templates? Answer: Templates are on the intranet, in the Resources section, inside the Templates folder. Always use the latest version with the updated logo.

title: FAQ: Cafeteria and Parking Hours
text: Question: What are the cafeteria hours? Answer: The cafeteria is open from 1:00 pm to 4:00 pm, Monday to Friday. Question: Do I need a card for the parking lot? Answer: Yes, request your parking card at the front desk by showing your employee badge.

title: FAQ: How Do I Request New Equipment?
text: Question: How do I request a new laptop or monitor? Answer: Submit a request in the support portal with the equipment you need and the reason. The request requires approval from your direct manager. Support will let you know when the equipment is ready for pickup.

title: FAQ: Who Is My Contact?
text: Question: Who should I ask? Answer: It depends on the topic.
